THE FREE CLIPPER KIT / 01
FIND THE MOMENT. KEEP THE PAYOFF.

Big stream.
Better clips.

Five practical tools for gaming streams, podcasts, lessons, and everything worth clipping. No account. No upload. Your footage stays yours.

5TOOLS. ZERO LOGINS.

Catch it while it happens.

Start alongside your stream or VOD. Tag a reaction, surprise, useful lesson, or payoff. This logs moments; it does not record or automatically detect footage.

TIMESTAMPS → CSV
SESSION CLOCK
00:00:00

Use MM:SS or HH:MM:SS. Leave blank to use the clock.

Tip: log the event, then watch a little earlier for context. Pick the actual in and out after reviewing.

Moment shortlist 0

    Open on the reason to watch.

    Turn a real event into three honest opening lines. These are deterministic writing templates, not AI predictions or a guarantee of views.

    SETUP → TENSION → PAYOFF

    Choose a line your footage supports. Show the evidence; do not spoil every payoff in the caption.

    Your opening options

    Add the event, obstacle, and outcome. Keep it specific.

    Test different openings on comparable clips. Judge with real watch behavior, not a made-up “viral score.”

    A shortlist, not thirty random cuts.

    Give each clip its own setup and payoff. Record the source, actual time range, opening, and context a new viewer needs.

    EDITABLE PLAN → CSV

    Planning only: this kit does not cut, upload, or publish video. Export the CSV and use it beside your editor. Keep each source’s permission and context intact.

    The same instinct. A different niche.

    Look for a meaningful change: expectation to surprise, confusion to clarity, effort to a result. Start with your own footage or permission.

    FOUR ANGLE PLAYBOOKS

    One format to carry across niches

    Promise → obstacle → visible result. A failed mission, a difficult question, a broken formula, or a missed rep can all tell that story. Preserve enough setup to make the result honest.

    Watch it like a stranger.

    Check the actual export, once with sound and once muted. This is a completion checklist, not a performance forecast.

    BEFORE YOU POST
    PREFLIGHT COMPLETION
    0 / 10

    Play your export. Check only what you have actually verified.

    After posting: compare actual viewer retention, completion, rewatches, and meaningful responses. Change one creative variable at a time.
